name: dota2modmanager-site
description: dota2modmanager.com - landing and docs. Built by Astro, served by Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.build: astro build && node tools/shots.mjs && node tools/preset-page.mjs && node tools/mirror.mjs
scripts.deploy:preview: astro build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name dota2modmanager --branch preview --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy: astro build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name dota2modmanager --branch main --commit-dirty=true && npm run indexnow
